name: Phantom

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Rogues who walk beside death itself, striking with the cries of the dead and carrying trinkets of departed souls.

feature.name: Wails from the Grave
feature.summary: After Sneak Attack, a second creature within 30 feet of the first takes half your Sneak Attack dice as Necrotic (Dexterity-modifier uses per Long Rest).
feature.text: Trigger: your Sneak Attack damage lands on a creature during your turn. Effect: choose a second creature in sight within 30 ft of the first and roll half your Sneak Attack dice, rounding up; it takes that total as Necrotic damage. Uses: Dexterity modifier (at least 1) per Long Rest.

feature.name: Whispers of the Dead
feature.summary: After each rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack (it replaces the previous one).
feature.text: After each Short or Long Rest, pick a skill or tool you aren't proficient with: a ghost lends you proficiency in it until you next use this to pick something else.

feature.name: Tokens of the Departed
feature.summary: Gain soul trinkets each Long Rest (2, more later): Advantage on death and Constitution saves while you hold one; spend one for a free Wails or an Augury; regain one when a creature dies near you.
feature.text: Each Long Rest leaves you with two soul trinkets (three from Rogue 13, four from 17): Tiny curios that crumble at your next Long Rest and blink back onto you if they end up more than 30 ft away. Holding at least one gives Advantage on Death Saving Throws and Constitution saves. Break one when your Sneak Attack lands to use Wails from the Grave without spending a use (Death's Knell), or as a Magic action to cast Augury with no components and Dexterity as the casting ability (Spirit Query). When a creature dies within 30 ft and in sight, a Reaction gets you one spent trinket back.

feature.name: Voice of Death
feature.summary: Cast Speak with Dead once per Short Rest without a slot or components, using Dexterity.
feature.text: Speak with Dead once per Short or Long Rest: no slot, no components, Dexterity as the casting ability.

feature.name: Ghost Walk
feature.summary: Bonus Action: a spectral form for 10 minutes (fly 10 ft and hover, attacks against you have Disadvantage, move through creatures). Once per Long Rest or a soul trinket.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action. For 10 minutes (or until you end it, free) you are a ghost: you fly at 10 ft and can hover; attackers roll at Disadvantage against you; and you pass through creatures as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force damage if a turn ends with you inside one. Recharges on a Long Rest, or at once by breaking a soul trinket (free).

feature.name: Death's Friend
feature.summary: Wails from the Grave also hits the first creature; regain a soul trinket on Initiative if you have none.
feature.text: Death's Lament: Wails from the Grave now hurts the first creature as well as the second. Draw of Death: rolling Initiative with no soul trinkets gives you one.
